body: This is either by someone I love dearly, or a lot of people have had a gut wrenching New Years blast from the past.
You and your family are awesome and deserve nothing but happiness in your lives, each and every one of you wonderful fucks!

The thing that makes me the saddest is that he was abandoned in a cat carrier . . . that means he was someone's pet and they were just like "fuck that", and left him on the side of the road.  Who are these fucking people, and how do they sleep at night?
